# Mandrel: a steel ring mandrel 0.72 m long on a wooden grip, lying along x, a gold ring on it.
# Origin on the bench under the grip end. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Steel --base-color 0.4118 0.6235 0.6784 --no-slot
material new Grip --base-color 0.4392 0.3020 0.1686 --no-slot
material new Gold --base-color 0.9098 0.6980 0.4353 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Taper --vertices 8 --radius1 0.1 --radius2 0.04 --depth 0.72 --location 0.66 0 0.1 --rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
material assign Steel
add mesh cylinder --name Grip --vertices 8 --radius 0.08 --depth 0.3 --location 0.15 0 0.08 --rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
material assign Grip
add mesh torus --name Ring --major-segments 10 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.085 --minor-radius 0.04 --location 0.62 0 0.1 --rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
material assign Gold
select Taper Grip Ring
active Taper
join
rename Taper Mandrel
shade flat
export mandrel.glb
